_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I3). Vito's '{3}{B}{B}: Creatures you control gain lifelink
until end of turn' makes EACH attacker its own lifegain event. Board: Vito, Dina, Tamanoa (none
sick), five Overgrown Tombs (painless), empty hand. The search activates the grant (all five
lands) and attacks with all three: 1 + 1 + 2 combat; lifelink events of 1, 1, 2 -> Vito drains
1 + 1 + 2, Dina drains 1 per event (3). Lifelink damage is COMBAT damage by a creature, so Tamanoa
does not trigger. Us 20 + 4 = 24; opponent 20 - 4 - 4 - 3 = 9. Without the grant: 20 / 16; an
implementation that aggregated the three lifelink hits into ONE event would read opponent 11.

battlefield.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
